findings.rationale: Em-dash present: 2 em-dash(es) across 1551 words. Em-dashes are banned from page copy ENTIRELY (v0.6.9 zero-tolerance, analyst-directed): they are the most recognised AI-content tell and clients flag them on review regardless of quality. Replace every one — full stop (usually best), comma, colon for label/value bullets ('2m³: from $250' or '2m³ from $250'), parentheses sparingly, 'to' for ranges. Count must be ZERO.
